title: デビュー戦の後に・達筆な焼き鳥屋

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… I… didn't get first!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Buuut I ran really fast! Wasn't that amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'm not even tired at all! I felt like I was just having fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I wanna keep racing! I get to run more after my debut, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's probably a good idea to participate in a variety of races to build up her experience anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And while she's at it, I'm sure she'll find a new race that she really wants to shoot for too.
choice_data_list: You know it! You're going to do so much running!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hm? Whaaat?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Look over there! My friends from the shopping district are here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I follow Haru Urara's line of sight and see her supportive shopping district friends all grouped together.

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Urara's here! Okay, everyone… now!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeepers
text_block_list.text: Congrats on your debut!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Flap…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow! You made a banner for me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The shopkeepers hold up a banner that says "Congratulations on your debut, Urara!"

text_block_list.name: Kind Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: I got so excited seeing you run so fast on the track!

text_block_list.name: Happy Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: We're gonna be with you all the way!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Aww, thanks! I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeepers
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's only just debuted, but it already feels like they're throwing a festival for her. It seems like the shopkeepers really love Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since they're expecting great things from Haru Urara, I promise to train her well!
